title: Oracle: rulings and handoff
body:
Three rulings from logged evidence: OD-1 decides output precision at 12 significant digits (R1000, citing ESC-1); OD-2 declines currency conversion, leaving the design offline non-goal standing (BL-4); OD-3 HALTS on BL-3, which cannot be honoured without the rich dependency vision tenet V5 forbids, and says what the owner would have to change in either direction.

Opened by the delivery driver on base run/web.
